args.query: monthly treasury statement receipts outlays deficit

sql: SELECT classification_desc, line_code_nbr, record_date, current_month_rcpt_outly_amt FROM econ.mts_outlays_by_function WHERE record_date IN ('2026-10-31','2025-10-31') ORDER BY CAST(line_code_nbr AS INTEGER), record_date
SELECT record_date, current_month_rcpt_outly_amt FROM econ.mts_outlays_by_function WHERE line_code_nbr='100' AND record_date >= '2025-09-30' ORDER BY record_date

args.url: https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v1/accounting/mts/mts_table_5?filter=record_date:in:(2026-10-31,2025-10-31),classification_desc:in:(Grants to States for Medicaid,Children's Health Insurance Program,Health Care Tax Credit)&fields=record_date,classification_desc,current_month_gross_outly_amt,current_month_net_outly_amt
